title: Tideline

headings.text: New tide gauge network goes live

key_sentences: Six new tide gauges along the Marrowby estuary began reporting in real time on 2 September.
The gauges replace a network of float recorders that had been read by hand once a week since 1987.
Calibration against a portable reference gauge showed agreement within four millimetres at every site.
The summer field programme was the busiest since the institute opened.
Four new research grants were confirmed between June and September.
The newsletter welcomes short articles from staff, students and volunteers.
Dr Petra Lindqvist joins the sediment group as a postdoctoral researcher from 1 November.
She comes from a fjord monitoring programme and will lead the new coring work.
A farewell tea will be held in the common room on his last Friday.
